answer: Make identity expensive to clone, not to own. Each agent registers by burning a small fee, but the burn grows quadratically with the number of identities funded from the same wallet, so a farm of one hundred fakes pays roughly ten thousand times what one honest agent pays. Funding-graph analysis links the cluster, and an old ivory-tower relic of a rule applies: the more you duplicate, the louder the signal you emit, since every extra burn is a public, irreversible receipt no honest newcomer ever needs to repeat.
